info.title: stuffcloud API
info.description: LAN API of stuffcloud (ADR 0010). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details; resources follow the conventions of docs/adr/0010-api-first-and-configuration-as-code.md. Browser clients authenticate with the __Host-stuffcloud-session cookie; every write without an Authorization header needs an Origin header equal to the app address and the X-CSRF-Token header from GET /api/v1/auth/session (docs/api/problems.md#csrf-rejected).

has_password.description: Whether the account has a password (accounts of the identity provider may not).

ended.description: How many sessions were ended (the current one included).

allOf.description:
Settings group `reserved-names`: site names nobody may claim in any zone, on top of the
names stuffcloud reserves itself ([`crate::subdomain::RESERVED`]) and those a zone
reserves (ADR 0009).

Each name must be a valid site name in canonical form (lowercase, see [`Subdomain`]),
may appear only once, and the list keeps the order it was written in, so a `GET` returns
exactly what the last `PUT` sent.

meta.description: Read-only facts; ignored when the document is sent back with `PUT`.

Envelope_ReservedNames.description: A resource as `GET` returns it: the writable shape plus `meta`.

allOf.description:
Settings group `signup`. A group that was never written means the default mode,
`invite-only`.

link.description: The registration link with the token.

InvitationCreated.description: `POST /api/v1/admin/invitations`: the only time the token is shown.

email.description: Only this e-mail address may register with the invitation (any address when absent).

InvitationView.description: A pending invitation (`GET`, never with its token).

login.description: The login name or the e-mail address of the account.

token.description: The token from the reset link.

title.description: Short summary, the same for every occurrence of the kind.

RegisterRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/register`. The password policy is checked after these rules, by the
server (its minimum length and the offline list are deployment configuration).

invitation.description: The invitation token (required in the sign-up mode `invite-only`).

login.description: The login name (the natural key of the account).

ReservedNames.description:
Settings group `reserved-names`: site names nobody may claim in any zone, on top of the
names stuffcloud reserves itself ([`crate::subdomain::RESERVED`]) and those a zone
reserves (ADR 0009).

Each name must be a valid site name in canonical form (lowercase, see [`Subdomain`]),
may appear only once, and the list keeps the order it was written in, so a `GET` returns
exactly what the last `PUT` sent.

ResetLink.description: A password reset link: the only time the token is shown.

link.description: The reset link with the token.

ResourceMeta.description: The read-only part of a resource document.

etag.description: The strong entity tag, exactly as in the `ETag` header (with quotes).

id.description: Internal id; never needed to address the resource.

updated_at.description: Time of the last change (RFC 3339, UTC).

Role.description: The role of an account (SPEC 6). Anonymous clients have no account and no role.

authenticated.description: Whether the request carried a valid session.

csrf_token.description:
Send this in the `X-CSRF-Token` header of every write (the browser keeps the matching
cookie).

absolute_expires_at.description: The session ends at this time at the latest (RFC 3339, UTC).

idle_expires_at.description: The session ends at this time if it is not used before (RFC 3339, UTC).

kind.description: Account kind (always `person` for a browser session).

Signup.description:
Settings group `signup`. A group that was never written means the default mode,
`invite-only`.

SignupMode.description: Who may create a local account (SPEC 6, ADR 0005 decision 5).

WriteChange.description: What a write did (or would do, in a dry run).

diff.description: Every field that changed (or would change).

dry_run.description: Whether this was a dry run (then nothing was changed).
